A reviewed primary source supplies a concrete mechanism not represented by the closed independent-cube child claim.

research_questions.statement: Can the source-faithful p-minus-one M16 construction turn its exact secp256k1 factor base into an independently recoverable relation stream whose complete equal-success cost scales below the generic baseline?
reopening_conditions: A separately authorized safe regime can distinguish the preregistered solver-slope and complete-cost laws.
The remaining rank, solving, recovery, preprocessing, sparse-linear-algebra, and common-cost obligations are specified without changing the threat model.

mechanism_variants.description: Apply the same order-three GLV scalar to every free Semaev coordinate and transport the target through the matching GLV orbit.
Replace each relation coordinate independently by u_i=x_i^3 and identify all erased coordinate phases at a fixed target.
Retain relative phases, fixed-target semantics, and recovery while changing a full cost quantity; no exact map currently exists.

Use the exact PKC 2016 p-minus-one map chain and affine-target System (4) at arity sixteen. The source map and polynomial input are specified for R != O; the repository resolves the source's ambiguous printed recovery line with a sound target-bound signed elliptic-curve acceptance filter. Direct-System-(4) recovery completeness, solver, and complete cost remain unresolved.

Use the exact order-564522 multiplicative subgroup as the source-faithful coordinate factor base at arity sixteen. HGP-M16-SOLVER-SLOPE-001 predates the exact factor-base census and remains an immutable historical snapshot; the current scoped seed requires a refreshed source-grounded proposal.

claims.statement: The independent coordinate quotient u_i=x_i^3 is not a faithful quotient of the fixed-target diagonal GLV-Semaev relation system because it erases relative phases outside the true diagonal action.
claims.scope: The exact independent-cube mechanism and dependent fixed-target premise only; faithful Petit, phase-preserving maps, non-scalar actions, and the parent route remain open or parked.
reopening_conditions: A new mechanism variant retains relative phases through an explicit recovery map and is not semantically equivalent to independent coordinate cubes.

claims.statement: A materially different phase-preserving GLV-Semaev construction with a complete recovery map and a non-orbit full-cost bridge has not yet been specified.
claims.scope: Absence of a current proposal in the reviewed repository, not a proof that no future GLV-Semaev algorithm can exist.
reopening_conditions: An exact phase-preserving mechanism contract is supplied and survives prior-art, recovery, cost-model, and validator review.

claims.statement: Within the enumerated coordinatewise C3 scalar action, only the diagonal C3 gives polynomial covariance for S3 and S4 under the certificate assumptions.
claims.scope: Exact finite coordinatewise scalar classification in the replayed symbolic model; not a Lean theorem and not a classification of non-scalar or birational automorphisms.
reopening_conditions: An independent replay finds a certificate mismatch or an omitted coordinatewise C3 action under the stated assumptions.

claims.statement: The checked S3 and S4 polynomial identities have the recorded diagonal GLV covariance and target-transport laws.
claims.scope: Positive polynomial and point-relation identities only; no exhaustive stabilizer, solving-degree, asymptotic, or ECDLP consequence.
reopening_conditions: A Lean regression, axiom-audit failure, or independently reproduced counterexample invalidates a named covariance declaration.

claims.statement: The immutable proposal's current at-most-24-bit calibration ladder is inapplicable to inference of the M16 exponent or complete-cost claim.
claims.scope: Only the execution regime frozen in HGP-M16-SOLVER-SLOPE-001; this does not falsify the M16 mechanism or close its parent cell or route.
reopening_conditions: Reopen this exact immutable-scope claim only if its proposal bytes, hash binding, or interpretation is shown erroneous; a larger proposal must use a new claim ID and may supersede this claim without changing its scoped truth.

claims.statement: The exact order-564522 subgroup has character sum 2532 for x^3+7, exactly 283527 liftable coordinates, 567054 signed affine factor points, and 94509 orbit classes after the free GLV action and elliptic-curve point negation.
claims.scope: Exact secp256k1 target-property census for the direct p-minus-one factor base; no relation, rank, solver, recovery, or complexity conclusion follows.
reopening_conditions: Reopen only if the public constants, subgroup definition, curve equation, or independently replayed certificate binding changes.

claims.statement: For a nonidentity affine sampled target, the published p-minus-one map specializes to L4 o L3 o L2 o L1 equals 1-x^564522 and a 64-coordinate, 65-equation direct System (4); the source's printed recovery line is target-ambiguous, so the canonical sound acceptance filter independently checks a signed relation against that target while leaving direct-System-(4) recovery completeness unproved.
claims.scope: Exact source-map and nonidentity affine input-system specification plus a repository-derived target-bound sound acceptance rule. Identity samples require resampling or separate handling. This claim does not prove complete recovery, a generalized-root solver, relation rank, solving or sparse-linear-algebra cost, total ECDLP cost, or route promotion.
reopening_conditions: Reopen only if the primary-source transcription, factor-chain arithmetic, affine-target domain, target-bound acceptance semantics, or independently replayed artifact binding is shown incorrect. Recovery completeness remains a separate open obligation rather than a reopening condition.
